description: Check an llms.txt against the format (H1 title, blockquote summary, H2 sections of `- [name](url): notes` links) and size. Pass `url` to check the file a site publishes, including whether its first 25 links answer; or pass `text` to check a file you have (a draft, a local copy), with `base` for where it lives and `links` to also test its links. Returns a short report with each issue and its line, and the sections with their link counts.

base.description: With text: the site or llms.txt link it belongs to, e.g. "example.com". Resolves relative links.

links.description: With text: also check that its first 25 links answer (and llms-full.txt next to base). Default false.

text.description: The llms.txt itself (up to 2 MB), instead of url.

url.description: A site, a docs section, or the llms.txt itself, e.g. "llmstxt.org" or "docs.astro.build/llms.txt". Use url or text.

name: check_llms_txt
title: Check an llms.txt
